To take the 18-year reading lease, a claimant now escrows 10,600 units for 36 hours, then at 19:05 sits 27 minutes at willow desk W-12 and writes a 140-character line with a door-bonded quill whose nib serial is live-checked in a desk-mounted mirror at 38 degrees. Three cameras plus a 0.22-mm stroke gauge must agree inside 55 seconds. If the hashes split, or the same nib retries inside 20 hours, 33 percent of the escrow is burned and W-12 stays sealed for 8 days.
